description:
Today the Explorer and corpus identify a run by platform name, so runs that differ only by execution engine (and later by deployment or gateway) merge into one platform: platform_id is the platform name (_project/scripts/explorer_pipeline/models.py:60), the meta-leaderboard keeps each platform's best rank per cohort, corpus identity is platform name (results-data/validate_corpus.py:407-431), and the read model carries only execution_mode sql/dataframe, tuning_mode and tuning_hash.

Work:
1. Read-model columns execution_engine (requested), execution_engine_applied, gateway and variant_id, derived through the core derive_variant_label (ADR D8), in _project/scripts/explorer_pipeline/{transformer,models,duckdb_builder}.py, mirrored in results-explorer/src/types.ts; bump the read-model version per scripts/publication/check_explorer_compat.py.
2. Cohort grouping, ranking and labels use variant_id ("Polars (streaming)", "Snowflake via Greybeam"); the Comparability receipt shows execution engine requested/applied and gateway.
3. Gateway runs carry ranking_exclusion_reason="gateway_routed" in native cohorts (ADR D9).
4. Legacy backfill: existing corpus bundles map through the legacy reader (requested=default unless streaming=true); no re-derive of published bytes.
5. Corpus identity in results-data/validate_corpus.py includes variant_id, with SEED_CORPUS_SPEC.md and CORPUS_NOTES.md updated in the same change.
